description: This PHP source file defines the 'Legacy' module class for the HTMLPurifier library, which manages deprecated HTML elements for backward compatibility. The class sets up legacy HTML elements, their attributes, and content models, to facilitate HTML sanitization conforming to older standards.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Legacy
classes.description: A class that extends HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule to implement legacy/deprecated HTML element support for HTMLPurifier, allowing transformation of deprecated elements into standards-compliant output.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initializes the legacy HTML elements and attributes supported by this module, adding elements like 'basefont', 'center', 'dir', etc., and configuring their properties such as 'formatting', 'content_model', and 'attributes'.
